comment: Quality profile presets shipped with the plugin (P4.FU9, user 2026-10-15; the approved Quality Profiles redesign). Each is created as an ordinary profile whose id is the preset id, so adding presets again never duplicates one. Qualities are best first: by resolution, then by source (remux, Blu-ray, WEB-DL, WEBRip, HDTV, DVD), falling back down to the preset's lowest resolution. maximumBytesPerHour is the preset's file size for its best resolution as the redesign draws it (Small: 4K 8, 2K 4, 1080p 2, 720p 1, SD 0.5 GB per hour; Balanced: 20, 10, 6, 3, 1.5; Large: no limit; 2K and 1080p are Balanced, 720p and SD Small, 4K and Any Quality Large, so the 4K preset has no size limit: user, 2026-10-19) (decimal GB per runtime hour); no preset sets a minimum, so a smaller lower-resolution copy is never refused when it falls back. Upgrades are off; the cutoff is the first quality, so turning upgrades on needs nothing else. Phase 12 (user, 2026-10-29): the 4K preset prefers Best on My TVs, and the 1080p preset prefers Plays Everywhere and is the quality profile for phones (phones: true) on a fresh install; there is no Mobile preset.

presets.name: 4K
presets.description: Best picture, big files. Falls back to lower quality if 4K is not available.

presets.name: 2K
presets.description: 1440p, a step below 4K at about half the size. Falls back to lower quality.

presets.name: 1080p
presets.description: Full HD, the sensible middle. Plays on phones too. Falls back to 720p.

presets.name: 720p
presets.description: Small files for small screens or slow links.

presets.name: Any Quality
presets.description: Best available of anything. Good for hard-to-find titles.

presets.name: SD
presets.description: 480p / 576p only. DVD rips and old TV.
